verdict.rationale: GitBook documents 'LLM-ready docs' and lists 'LLM optimizations' on its pricing page. A probe confirms llms.txt returns HTTP 200, and an llms-full.txt full-content variant is live on GitBook's own GitBook-hosted docs, so both files are served in practice. Missing for 10: verbatim first-party documentation that every customer-published site generates llms.txt and llms-full.txt automatically, and independent corroboration on a third-party GitBook site.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site automatically serves llms.txt (and a full-content variant) so agents can index it

citations.quote: Write in the editor, drive it from your agent, or sync from Git.
